planningNotes.approachesConsidered: (1) Multi-node gate at ACTIVATION — REJECTED by design-fidelity verification: design 291/396/1322 place the admission pass at SUBMISSION VALIDATION (a 2-node graph must never reach PLAN_REVIEW); activation-time check is defense-in-depth only. (2) UNSUPPORTED via registry code — impossible: closed RUNTIME_ERROR_CODES has no UNSUPPORTED family; FANOUT_* codes cannot carry node data (RUNTIME_SAFE_DETAIL_KEYS has no count key); chose a core-local typed third result variant {ok:false, unsupported:true, ...} — precedented (skills/runner domain-local *_UNSUPPORTED codes) and matches the design's literal 'typed UNSUPPORTED'. (3) Caller-computed executionBearingNodeCount — rejected: unverifiable claim, not a provable metric; witness carries the typed node summary list (nodeKey + executionBearing, DAEMON_VERIFIED floor) and the reducer derives the count. (4) REVISION_REBOUND for all hash mismatches — rejected: registry validSources exclude PLANNING_RUN (createRuntimeError silently degrades to UNKNOWN_ERROR); planning-run uses ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, graph-revision may use REVISION_REBOUND/SUPERSEDED_AUTHORITY. (5) bare planning.cancel for INITIAL runs — rejected: design rows 301-302 make planning.cancel expansion-only; INITIAL cancellation requires goal-cancel authorization witness (exactly HUMAN_APPROVED) + terminal proof. (6) @moe/scheduler dependency for NodeSummary — rejected: layering inversion + package.json churn; witness data only. Verified by 2-agent workflow (design-fidelity + conventions); 2 BLOCKERs + 6 RISKs folded in.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Landed core conventions catalog (verified): result shapes <X>AcceptedResult/<X>RejectedResult/union, deep-frozen; reduce<X>(state|undefined, command); check order snapshot->create->state->expectedVersion(ILLEGAL_TRANSITION)->version(EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT)->commandId(IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT only where source-valid)->TRANSITIONS lookup->overflow guard(multi-event versionDelta)->apply; truth floors goal-validation.ts:145-186 (strongTruth=DAEMON_VERIFIED|HUMAN_APPROVED ONLY — OBSERVED rejects; cancel/reopen exactly HUMAN_APPROVED); successor pattern goal-reducer.ts:167-187; compound multi-event version accounting (combined close precedent); goal.activate_initial_graph exists and owns graphEpoch increment (goal-reducer.ts:106-115) — revision activation carries reference data, daemon composes three reducers atomically. Root index exports ONLY project+goal (identity absent — its own anomaly with area index + shims; do not fix as drive-by). Registry validSources (error-registry.ts): ILLEGAL_TRANSITION+EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT valid both aggregates; IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: GOAL/NODE_RUN/PLANNING_RUN/PROJECT (NOT GRAPH_REVISION); REVISION_REBOUND: ATTEMPT/GRAPH_REVISION/NODE_RUN (NOT PLANNING_RUN); SUPERSEDED_AUTHORITY: not PLANNING_RUN; PLANNING_SUBMISSION_FINALIZING: PLANNING_RUN with sourceState detail. Vocabularies confirmed exact: PLANNING_RUN 9 states, GRAPH_REVISION 6 states; PLANNING_FENCE/PLANNING_HOLD are separate aggregates — never conflate. scheduler graph-model.ts:31 has executionBearing per node but is scheduler-internal.
planningNotes.risks: (1) Silent error-code degrade: createRuntimeError falls back to UNKNOWN_ERROR on source/code mismatch — every rejection test must assert the INTENDED code so a degrade fails loudly. (2) Admission-gate placement is the DoD2 make-or-break: multi-node refusal at submission finalization with REJECTED+successor, not at activation. (3) Three-reducer J1 composition: reducers stay pure; atomicity is the daemon's job — document the contract, do not reach across aggregates. (4) Epoch authority: goal owns graphEpoch; revision carrying its own counter would fork authority. (5) SUBMISSION_DRAINING facets: live-planner-effect is a state facet, not a lifecycle — don't invent states outside the closed vocabulary. (6) Preview scope: REVISION/EXPANSION/SUPERSEDED paths typed but rejected — QA may flag 'dead states'; contract comments cite design lines + Phase 5. (7) Shared tree: runner task WORKING — attribute red repo gates; explicit-pathspec commit of exactly 8 paths.

implementationPlan.description: Study landed conventions before writing anything: packages/core/src/goal/{goal-contract,goal-reducer,goal-validation}.ts and project equivalents. Clone EXACTLY: result shapes <X>AcceptedResult {events, ok:true, state, successor?} / <X>RejectedResult {error: RuntimeError, ok:false} / union type, deep-frozen via local deepFreeze; reducer signature reduce<X>(state | undefined, command) where undefined accepts only the create kind with expectedVersion===0; check order: snapshot command -> create path -> snapshot state -> expectedVersion validity (ILLEGAL_TRANSITION) -> version mismatch (EXPECTED_VERSION_CONFLICT) -> commandId presence (IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT — ONLY where the source aggregate is registry-valid) -> frozen TRANSITIONS lookup -> version-overflow guard (accounts multi-event versionDelta) -> per-command apply; witness-validation failures reject ILLEGAL_TRANSITION, malformed snapshots unknownFailure; truth floors from goal-validation.ts:145-186 — strongTruth admits ONLY DAEMON_VERIFIED|HUMAN_APPROVED (OBSERVED rejects), destructive/authorization witnesses require exactly HUMAN_APPROVED; successor pattern GoalSuccessorData (goal-reducer.ts:167-187: frozen successor data on the accepted result, old aggregate never moves backward); core-local command kinds beyond RUNTIME_COMMAND_KINDS are precedented. Naming: per-aggregate exports PLANNING_RUN_COMMAND_KINDS/PLANNING_RUN_TRANSITIONS/reducePlanningRun and GRAPH_REVISION_COMMAND_KINDS/GRAPH_REVISION_TRANSITIONS/reduceGraphRevision. Two aggregates share the planning/ directory deliberately (contract+validation shared, one reducer file each).

TDD red — planning-run-reducer.test.ts. Lifecycles from RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES.PLANNING_RUN (typeof [number] derivation, goal-contract.ts:4 precedent). Exhaustive matrix over the INITIAL-kind linear subset (design table 280-306): planning.create_draft (undefined -> DRAFT, expectedVersion 0); readiness witness DRAFT -> READY (immutable intent/criteria base ref + finite planning-budget ref, strongTruth floor); planning.claim READY -> PLANNING (attempt/lease/slot/context references bind; also legal from unowned-resumable PLANNING with prior-attempt-terminal-proof + handoff-or-NO_HANDOFF_RECOVERY witness refs); planning.release PLANNING -> PLANNING (attempt RELEASED, sealed handoff ref, run becomes unowned-resumable — ownership modeled as a state facet {owned: boolean, resumable: boolean}); planning.recover_absent owned/SUSPECT-facet PLANNING -> unowned resumable PLANNING (NO_HANDOFF_RECOVERY witness: negative-proof refs, missing in-memory state recorded UNKNOWN); plan.propose kind INITIAL seals submissionHash: with live-planner-effect facet -> SUBMISSION_DRAINING; without -> directly finalization-eligible PLANNING; plan.propose kinds REVISION|EXPANSION are TYPED but return the core-local UNSUPPORTED variant (preview scope); submission-finalize witness (attempt/effect/resources/slot terminal proof, strongTruth) from PLANNING-no-live-effect or SUBMISSION_DRAINING: (a) ADMISSION PASS runs HERE (design 291/396/1322 — the single-node gate is at submission validation, NOT activation): witness carries typed node summary list readonly {nodeKey, executionBearing: boolean}[] (DAEMON_VERIFIED floor); reducer derives the count itself — more than one execution-bearing node returns the typed UNSUPPORTED variant and the run moves to REJECTED with successor data (refusal row 293); (b) validation success -> PLAN_REVIEW, one result atomically records planRevision {planHash} + graphRevision content ref {graphContentHash} + dependency/quality refs; (c) core proposal refusal (typed findings ref) -> REJECTED + frozen successor-run data (GoalSuccessorData pattern; dedup is the ledger's job); PLAN_REVIEW + exact plan approval (binds planHash+graphContentHash+qualityHash+dependencyHash, all hex64) -> APPROVED (no execution authority); hash mismatch ANYWHERE -> ILLEGAL_TRANSITION (NOT REVISION_REBOUND — registry validSources exclude PLANNING_RUN; createRuntimeError silently degrades invalid sources to UNKNOWN_ERROR), zero state change; identical-byte re-present accepted idempotently by exact hash (line 306); PLAN_REVIEW REVISE_PLAN (findings ref, HUMAN_APPROVED) -> REJECTED + successor data; goal-cancel authorization witness (exactly HUMAN_APPROVED + no-live/unknown-effect terminal proof) -> CANCELLED — NO bare planning.cancel for INITIAL runs (design rows 301-302: planning.cancel is expansion-only; initial cancellation authority is goal.cancel); compound graph.approve PLAN_REVIEW -> ACTIVATED (J1: plan-decision + graph-decision + activation in ONE result; activation witness binds graph/quality/BUDGET/POLICY hashes + expectedGoalVersion per design 528, goal must be DRAFT with no active revision — witness refs); initial APPROVED -> ACTIVATED via graph.approve similarly. SUPERSEDED and every expansion/supersession transition: representable, always rejected (preview). PLANNING_SUBMISSION_FINALIZING (sourceState detail) used when commands arrive during SUBMISSION_DRAINING that the drain forbids. Assert code+details on every rejection; matrix completeness derived mechanically. Confirm RED.

Green — planning-contract.ts + planning-validation.ts (each target <=250, split before 400). planning-contract.ts: PlanningRunLifecycle/GraphRevisionLifecycle derived from RUNTIME_LIFECYCLES; typed frozen commands + witnesses per step 2; PlanningRunState {runId, goalRef, kind: "INITIAL" (REVISION/EXPANSION in the type union for forward-compat), lifecycle, owned/resumable/livePlannerEffect facets, attemptRef|null, leaseRef|null, submissionHash|null, planHash|null, graphRevisionRef|null, approvedHashes|null {planHash, graphContentHash, qualityHash, dependencyHash}, version}; GraphRevisionState {revisionId, goalRef, lifecycle, graphContentHash, planHash, boundHashes|null {graphHash, qualityHash, budgetHash, policyHash, expectedGoalVersion}, version}; NodeSummary {nodeKey, executionBearing}; the typed UNSUPPORTED result variant — THIRD discriminated union member {ok: false, unsupported: true, reason: "MULTI_NODE_EXECUTION_UNSUPPORTED", executionBearingNodeKeys: readonly string[]} — DOCUMENTED as the deliberate exception to registry-only rejections (no UNSUPPORTED code exists in the closed registry; FANOUT_* codes cannot carry counts — RUNTIME_SAFE_DETAIL_KEYS has no count key; precedent for domain-local typed codes: skills SKILL_MANIFEST_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED, runner RUNNER_WORKSPACE_PATH_KIND_UNSUPPORTED); events (PlanningRunCreated, PlanningRunReady, PlanningClaimed, PlanningReleased, PlanningRecoveredAbsent, PlanningSubmissionSealed, PlanRevisionCreated, PlanningRunRejected, PlanApproved, PlanningRunActivated, PlanningRunCancelled) each echoing commandId. planning-validation.ts: hex64/witness/truth-floor guards cloned from goal-validation.ts (strongTruth two-value floor; HUMAN_APPROVED-exact for cancel/REVISE_PLAN authorization). NO @moe/scheduler import — core depends only on @moe/contracts; node summaries arrive as witness data (layering + package.json unchanged). planning-run tests green.

TDD red then green — graph-revision-reducer.test.ts + graph-revision-reducer.ts. Matrix (design 526-528): create DRAFT (immutable content: graphContentHash+planHash fixed at creation, never mutated after — any content-mutation command rejects); DRAFT -> PENDING_APPROVAL (submission ref); PENDING_APPROVAL -> APPROVED (approval witness binding graphHash+qualityHash+budgetHash+policyHash+expectedGoalVersion — full design-528 hash set); APPROVED -> ACTIVE (activation); canonical COMPOUND activation from PENDING_APPROVAL emits APPROVED + ACTIVE events in one result (or APPROVED -> ACTIVE single event), version bumped once per event with overflow guard accounting versionDelta (goal-reducer compound-close precedent); graphEpoch is REFERENCE DATA to the goal aggregate's epoch authority (goal.activate_initial_graph already increments it — goal-reducer.ts:106-115): the revision activation result carries {goalRef, expectedGoalVersion} so the daemon composes THREE reducer results atomically (planning-run graph.approve + graph-revision activation + goal.activate_initial_graph) — document this composition contract in the module header; DRAFT|PENDING_APPROVAL|APPROVED -> REJECTED pre-activation; never backward; SUPERSEDED representable, all entries rejected (preview). Error codes for THIS reducer (source aggregate GRAPH_REVISION): REVISION_REBOUND IS valid here — use it for stale-binding hash mismatch on activation; SUPERSEDED_AUTHORITY valid here (expectedEpoch/observedEpoch details); IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT is NOT valid from GRAPH_REVISION (registry srcs GOAL/NODE_RUN/PLANNING_RUN/PROJECT) — the empty-commandId branch uses ILLEGAL_TRANSITION or unknownFailure instead of cloning the goal pattern verbatim (createRuntimeError silently degrades invalid sources to UNKNOWN_ERROR — test asserts the CHOSEN code actually surfaces, catching a silent degrade). Stale approval bytes (DoD3): approval/activation carrying hashes that mismatch the revision's sealed content rejects with zero state change; property test: content hashes NEVER change after creation across any accepted command sequence.

planning-invariants.test.ts (covers BOTH aggregates — deliberate deviation from one-dir-per-aggregate, documented) + root index exports. Seeded xorshift32 property tests (landed *-invariants precedent, no fast-check): (1) no backward transition ever accepted for either aggregate across random command sequences; (2) multi-node graphs (2+ execution-bearing nodes in the witness list) NEVER reach PLAN_REVIEW, APPROVED, or ACTIVATED — the UNSUPPORTED variant surfaces at submission finalization and the run is REJECTED (DoD2); (3) stale approval bytes: random hash perturbation (flip one hex char) always rejects with zero state change on both aggregates (DoD3); (4) draft-vs-active authority: after a revision is ACTIVE, every content/approval mutation rejects; a REJECTED planning run never regains authority; successor data never aliases old state (deep-inequality of references); (5) deep-frozen results everywhere (recursive isFrozen walk); (6) determinism: same seed -> identical trace; (7) compound activation: exactly one result carries the full J1 event set and intermediate states are never observable. Root index: append per-aggregate export blocks to packages/core/src/index.ts following the EXACT landed structure (value block per reducer module + type block from planning-contract.js, type names alphabetized within blocks, append-chronological block order). Do NOT touch identity's missing export (not this task's drive-by), no area index, no .js shims (project/goal precedent — identity's shims are its own anomaly).

(2) Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test` -> exit 0 — complete_task evidence: { command: "pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test", exitCode: 0, outputTail } (existing project/goal/identity suites must pass untouched — zero edits outside planning/ + index.ts). (5) Run focused suite twice — identical; `git status --porcelain` shows only owned paths.
